title: Hanasato Minori — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Minori?
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, hi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was just thinking about which committee to join since we have to choose tomorrow during homeroom...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you not sure which you'd like to join?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I've already made my decision!
I'm gonna stay with the animal caretaker committee!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we've been so busy lately that I'm not sure if I'll be at school enough for it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm wondering if it's okay for me to stay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah, I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku was on the cleanup committee last year and said it was fine for credit-based students to join...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We rotate duties for the animal caretaker committee, so I'd feel awful for the animals if I suddenly can't make it because of work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd just end up causing the other committee members a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I actually think you'll be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What makes you say that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember Shizuku mentioning this a while ago, but since it's hard for credit-based students to be present each time, they're usually scheduled in less for the rotations.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, in the event that credit-based members are unable to make it, the committee makes sure that there's always a regular member available to fill in as a substitute. So, I wouldn't worry too much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
I didn't realize they had that sort of system in place...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I think you should stay on the animal caretaker committee if you really want to, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You'll have to figure out a way to juggle that with work, but if the committee is okay to accommodate for you, I'd say there is no reason for you to quit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Plus, I value these committees a lot since they seem like an integral part of school life.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Haruka, you were credit-based in junior high, right? Were you on any committees back then...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nope.
I avoided joining any for the exact reasons you just mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which I really began to regret after talking to Shizuku. I wish I were on some back then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, to reiterate, I think you should stay with the animal caretaker committee if that's what you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for me, if possible, I'd like to be on the planning committee for the school or sports festivals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, festival planning...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think that really suits you, Haruka, since you know how to get everyone into a festive mood!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Pun intended?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, it's really hard to say if we're going to be free for either of those things. So, again, if I get the chance...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I really hope so!
I also wanna be there for those this year!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We'd really need to count our lucky stars if we managed to be there for both.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But I'm really glad I asked you about this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've made my decision!
I'm gonna stay on the animal caretaker committee!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Do your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, Minori, why is it that you want to stay with the animal caretaker committee so much? Any particular reason?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... It's not like I have any reason in particular...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I sorta don't want to say goodbye to all the animals I took care of last year...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They all seem to like being around me, and they even started responding by hopping towards me whenever I called their names.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's really cute.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, to be fair, that pretty much only happens when I'm carrying around their food...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But they're so unbelievably cute!
They'll hop onto my lap sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which usually ends with my uniform getting all dirty, but that always puts a huge smile on my face♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I think you're just the person the animal caretaker committee needs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
If you're willing to say that, Haruka, that means I'll need to contribute more and more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I'm gonna do my best!
Also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna become the committee's number-one caretaker! The one that the animals love the most!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Their number-one caretaker...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, actually, that goal does suit you.
